meeting_scene: The team gathered around the conference table, their faces a mix of fatigue and focus as they awaited Alex's opening remarks. "Hey everyone," Alex said with an easy smile, "just wanted to make sure we're all good on our deadlines for that upcoming project." As Sam scribbled some notes while Priya subtly adjusted her cup holder – habits she'd developed during stressful periods like these - Jordan chimed in next, his enthusiasm evident as he discussed the team's progress and minor triumphs. Meanwhile, Riya quietly observed from a corner of the table, maintaining an air of attentiveness that belied any recent thoughts; it was just one aspect of her dedication to doing things by design.
